findings.text: The eval on line 46 processes user-provided test description ($2) without sanitization, allowing command injection via malicious test names like $(malicious_command).
After the argument parsing loop breaks on '--', $* is empty, so BATS_TEST_NAMES receives an empty string instead of the actual test name, breaking test selection.
The comparison uses $* which is empty after the loop, so the test name match always fails and BATS_TEST_TAGS/BATS_TEST_DESCRIPTION are never set for the selected test.
The ${1?} parameter expansion will cause a hard error if _bats_test_functions_setup is called without an argument, potentially breaking test initialization.

0.reason: The eval on line 46 executes arbitrary code from the test description without sanitization, allowing command injection.

3.reason: The ${1?} parameter expansion is intentional to require an argument, and the function is documented to be called with BATS_TEST_NUMBER.
